rule: The crops are 32x512x512, capped by the test region. They tile the bounding box of the annotation without overlap and stay clear of tuning data. Crops with fewer than 20% of the median object count of the dataset are left out. 2d sets without an entry are scored on the whole image (FULL_IMAGE_2D in common.py) or on the 512x512 center crop. The note of a dataset gives its exceptions.
